sections.text: The American soccer conversation stretches well beyond ninety minutes. This demo feature imagines a publication following those connections as carefully as it follows a league table.

sections.heading: The big picture
sections.text: Start with the official league schedule and your club’s website. Confirm kickoff time, time zone, venue and any schedule changes. Keep a match tracker open if you cannot watch, and read more than one report for context.

sections.heading: What to look for
sections.text: Watch what happens before the ball arrives. A midfielder checking a shoulder, a winger holding width, and a defender stepping forward can open a passing lane. Looking for these small decisions makes a match easier to understand, even when the score does not change.
